name: zsnd_cd_shutdown
description: zSndCd::Shutdown stops CD playback, closes the MCI CD device, clears the ready flag, frees configured track records, unlinks track nodes, and returns 1.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke covers list and state teardown without requiring a live MCI CD device.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a24d0 validates zSndCd::Stop, optional MCI_CLOSE on the low word of g_zSndCdDeviceId, clearing the device id and ZSND_CD_FLAG_READY, freeing each track entry archiveName plus entry object, unlinking and deleting every track node, decrementing g_zSndCd_TrackCount, and returning 1.
The native smoke verifies configured track-list cleanup and shutdown state reset.
